Anduril Industries is a defense technology company developing advanced systems for U.S. and allied military capabilities. The Space team is seeking an Emerging Talent Orbital Software Engineer to develop, integrate, test, and deploy software supporting on-orbit spacecraft operations, mission management, and multi-domain systems. The role involves collaborating with engineering teams and end-users to deliver reliable mission capabilities for defense and intelligence customers.
